en.name: John Paul II
en.summary: One of the longest-serving popes, previously Archbishop of Krakow.
en.body: John Paul II (Karol Wojtyla, 1920-2005) served as pope from 1978 until his death, and was canonized in 2014.

fr.name: Jean-Paul II
fr.summary: L'un des papes ayant servi le plus longtemps, auparavant archevêque de Cracovie.
fr.body: Jean-Paul II (Karol Wojtyła, 1920-2005) fut pape de 1978 jusqu'à sa mort, et fut canonisé en 2014.
